description: AT Record written to the owning DID's AT Repo every time updateRef succeeds. Travels the com.atproto.sync firehose so peer PDS instances can mirror the ref graph without polling. Immutable per rkey; ref history reconstructed by concatenating all refUpdate records for a given (ownerDid, refName).

reason.description: Required when updateKind in {rolledBack, forcePushed}. Free text logged to audit trail.

committerDid.description: DID that invoked updateRef. May differ from the commit's authorDid.
